content:
Currently the abel tactic supports changing the transparency settings used when identifying atoms. This is never used anywhere in Mathlib (except the test suite), and I search fairly hard for it in downstream repositories and found nothing.

So I would like to remove this functionality, as needless complexity (that potentially gets in the way of future refactors).

I have two competing PRs up, #44500 which outrights removes this, and #44501, which adds a warning to these features, a suggestion to post on zulip if you have a use case, and a set_option to suppress the warning.
